note: Each claim is one rendered observation on the canonical page. claims.title: The Baptism of Rus'
claims.summary: Grand Prince Volodymyr the Great adopted Christianity in the Byzantine rite and had the people of Kyiv baptized, bringing Rus' into Eastern Christendom and shaping the culture of the East Slavs.

sources.label: Kyiv: Saint-Sophia Cathedral and Related Monastic Buildings, Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-988-the-baptism-of-rus, claim TL:UKR:event:988:the-baptism-of-rus, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Reign of Yaroslav the Wise
claims.summary: Yaroslav consolidated Kievan Rus', codified the Russkaya Pravda, promoted Christianity and learning, and built the Saint-Sophia Cathedral, marking the height of the realm.

sources.label: Kyiv: Saint-Sophia Cathedral and Related Monastic Buildings, Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1019-reign-of-yaroslav-the-wise, claim TL:UKR:event:1019:reign-of-yaroslav-the-wise, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Saint-Sophia Cathedral begun in Kyiv
claims.summary: Built with Byzantine masters under Yaroslav the Wise as the main church of the Rus' capital, Saint-Sophia symbolised Kyiv as a 'new Constantinople'; it is now a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

sources.label: Kyiv: Saint-Sophia Cathedral and Related Monastic Buildings, Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1037-saint-sophia-cathedral-begun-in-kyiv, claim TL:UKR:event:1037:saint-sophia-cathedral-begun-in-kyiv, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Principality of Galicia-Volhynia formed
claims.summary: Roman Mstyslavych united Galicia and Volhynia into a single powerful principality in the south-west, one of the major successor states to emerge as Kievan Rus' fragmented.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1199-principality-of-galicia-volhynia-formed, claim TL:UKR:event:1199:principality-of-galicia-volhynia-formed, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Mongol sack of Kyiv
claims.summary: The Mongols of the Golden Horde stormed and destroyed Kyiv, ending its dominance and breaking the political unity of the Rus' lands.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1240-mongol-sack-of-kyiv, claim TL:UKR:event:1240:mongol-sack-of-kyiv, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Rus' lands pass to Lithuania and Poland
claims.summary: Following the collapse of Galicia-Volhynia, most of the former Rus' lands were absorbed by the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, while Galicia in the west passed to the Kingdom of Poland.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1340-rus-lands-pass-to-lithuania-and-poland, claim TL:UKR:event:1340:rus-lands-pass-to-lithuania-and-poland, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Rise of the Cossacks
claims.summary: On the southern steppe frontier free men known as Cossacks emerged, evolving by the mid-sixteenth century a democratic military organisation with an assembly, the rada, and elected hetmans.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1500-rise-of-the-cossacks, claim TL:UKR:event:1500:rise-of-the-cossacks, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Zaporozhian Sich
claims.summary: The Cossacks established the Zaporozhian Sich, a fortified camp on the lower Dnieper that became the political and military heart of Cossack Ukraine and a bastion of Orthodox resistance.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1556-the-zaporozhian-sich, claim TL:UKR:event:1556:the-zaporozhian-sich, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Union of Lublin brings Ukraine into the Commonwealth
claims.summary: The union of Poland and Lithuania placed the bulk of the Ukrainian lands within the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, intensifying pressures of serfdom and Catholicism on the Orthodox population.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1569-union-of-lublin-brings-ukraine-into-the, claim TL:UKR:event:1569:union-of-lublin-brings-ukraine-into-the, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Khmelnytsky's uprising
claims.summary: Bohdan Khmelnytsky led the Zaporozhian Cossacks, allied with the Crimean Tatars, in a great rebellion against Polish rule, founding a self-governing Cossack Hetmanate in the Ukrainian lands.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1648-khmelnytsky-s-uprising, claim TL:UKR:event:1648:khmelnytsky-s-uprising, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Council of Pereiaslav
claims.summary: Khmelnytsky and the Cossack assembly swore allegiance to the tsar, placing the Hetmanate under Muscovite protection while seeking to retain its autonomy, and drawing Muscovy into war with Poland.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1654-council-of-pereiaslav, claim TL:UKR:event:1654:council-of-pereiaslav, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Partition along the Dnieper
claims.summary: The Truce of Andrusovo and later settlements divided the Ukrainian lands between Russia and Poland, with the left bank and Kyiv under Russian control and the right bank remaining Polish.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1667-partition-along-the-dnieper, claim TL:UKR:event:1667:partition-along-the-dnieper, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Destruction of the Zaporozhian Sich
claims.summary: Russian troops destroyed the Zaporozhian Sich, the bastion of Cossack self-government, completing the suppression of Cossack autonomy under the Russian Empire.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1775-destruction-of-the-zaporozhian-sich, claim TL:UKR:event:1775:destruction-of-the-zaporozhian-sich, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Galicia to Austria, right bank to Russia
claims.summary: The partitions of Poland transferred Galicia to the Habsburg Empire in 1772 and most of the right-bank Ukrainian lands to the Russian Empire by 1795, dividing the Ukrainian people between two empires.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1772-galicia-to-austria-right-bank-to-russia, claim TL:UKR:event:1772:galicia-to-austria-right-bank-to-russia, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Shevchenko publishes 'Kobzar'
claims.summary: The poet Taras Shevchenko, born a serf, published his collection Kobzar, giving voice to a distinct Ukrainian nation and laying the foundations of the modern Ukrainian literary language.

sources.label: Taras Shevchenko, Ukrainian poet and national hero

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1840-shevchenko-publishes-kobzar, claim TL:UKR:event:1840:shevchenko-publishes-kobzar, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Ukrainian People's Republic proclaimed
claims.summary: Amid the Russian Revolution, the Central Rada in Kyiv under Mykhailo Hrushevsky proclaimed the Ukrainian People's Republic, the first modern Ukrainian state.

sources.label: Ukraine: World War I and the struggle for independence

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1917-ukrainian-people-s-republic-proclaimed, claim TL:UKR:event:1917:ukrainian-people-s-republic-proclaimed, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Declaration of independence
claims.summary: The Central Rada's Fourth Universal proclaimed the full independence of the Ukrainian People's Republic from Russia, as German, Bolshevik and other forces contested the country.

sources.label: Ukraine: World War I and the struggle for independence

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1918-declaration-of-independence, claim TL:UKR:event:1918:declaration-of-independence, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Defeat and Soviet incorporation
claims.summary: After years of war between Bolshevik, Polish, White and Ukrainian forces, the People's Republic was defeated; most Ukrainian lands were incorporated into the Soviet state, while Galicia passed to Poland.

sources.label: Ukraine: World War I and the struggle for independence

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1921-defeat-and-soviet-incorporation, claim TL:UKR:event:1921:defeat-and-soviet-incorporation, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Holodomor
claims.summary: Soviet collectivisation and grain seizures caused a man-made famine that killed millions of Ukrainians; many states and, in 2022, the European Parliament have recognised it as a genocide.

sources.label: Holodomor: Parliament recognises Soviet starvation of Ukrainians as genocide

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1932-the-holodomor, claim TL:UKR:event:1932:the-holodomor, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Babyn Yar massacre
claims.summary: German SS and police units shot 33,771 Jews at the Babyn Yar ravine outside Kyiv over two days; in all some 100,000 people were murdered there during the occupation.

sources.label: Mass Shootings at Babyn Yar (Babi Yar)

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1941-babyn-yar-massacre, claim TL:UKR:event:1941:babyn-yar-massacre, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Crimea transferred to the Ukrainian SSR
claims.summary: The Presidium of the Supreme Soviet transferred the Crimean Peninsula from the Russian SFSR to the Ukrainian SSR, citing economic and geographic ties, an administrative change within the USSR.

sources.label: Transfer of Crimea to the Ukrainian SSR, 19 February 1954
sources.publisher: Mission of the President of Ukraine in the Autonomous Republic of Crimea

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1954-crimea-transferred-to-the-ukrainian-ssr, claim TL:UKR:event:1954:crimea-transferred-to-the-ukrainian-ssr, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Chernobyl disaster
claims.summary: An explosion at the Chernobyl nuclear plant in northern Ukraine caused the worst nuclear accident in history, exposing Soviet failings and fuelling Ukrainian discontent in the final Soviet years.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1986-chernobyl-disaster, claim TL:UKR:event:1986:chernobyl-disaster, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Declaration of independence
claims.summary: Amid the collapse of the Soviet Union, Ukraine's parliament declared independence on 24 August 1991, confirmed by referendum on 1 December with over 90 percent voting in favour.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1991-declaration-of-independence, claim TL:UKR:event:1991:declaration-of-independence, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Budapest Memorandum
claims.summary: Ukraine agreed to surrender its nuclear arsenal and join the Non-Proliferation Treaty; Russia, the US and the UK pledged to respect its sovereignty and existing borders and to refrain from the use of force against it.

sources.label: Budapest Memorandum on security assurances (Ukraine's accession to the NPT), 5 December 1994

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-1994-budapest-memorandum, claim TL:UKR:event:1994:budapest-memorandum, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Orange Revolution
claims.summary: Mass protests against a fraudulent presidential election forced a court-ordered re-run that brought the pro-Western Viktor Yushchenko to the presidency over Viktor Yanukovych.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-2004-the-orange-revolution, claim TL:UKR:event:2004:the-orange-revolution, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Revolution of Dignity (Euromaidan)
claims.summary: Protests sparked by the rejection of an EU association agreement grew into the Revolution of Dignity; after deadly clashes President Yanukovych fled the country in February 2014.

sources.label: Ukraine crisis of 2013-14 (Euromaidan, annexation of Crimea, war in the Donbas)

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-2014-revolution-of-dignity-euromaidan, claim TL:UKR:event:2014:revolution-of-dignity-euromaidan, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Russia annexes Crimea; UN Resolution 68/262
claims.summary: Russia seized Crimea and declared its annexation after a referendum deemed illegal; the UN General Assembly adopted Resolution 68/262, affirming Ukraine's territorial integrity and declaring the referendum without legal validity.

sources.label: Ukraine crisis of 2013-14 (Euromaidan, annexation of Crimea, war in the Donbas)
General Assembly Resolution 68/262, Territorial integrity of Ukraine (27 March 2014)
United Nations Resolution Declares Crimea Referendum Invalid
sources.publisher: U.S. Library of Congress, Global Legal Monitor

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-2014-russia-annexes-crimea-un-resolution-68-262, claim TL:UKR:event:2014:russia-annexes-crimea-un-resolution-68-262, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Full-scale invasion; UN Resolution ES-11/1
claims.summary: Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine; the UN General Assembly adopted Resolution ES-11/1 deploring the aggression and demanding the immediate, complete and unconditional withdrawal of all Russian forces.

sources.label: Russia-Ukraine War (2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine)
General Assembly Resolution ES-11/1, Aggression against Ukraine (2 March 2022)

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-2022-full-scale-invasion-un-resolution-es-11-1, claim TL:UKR:event:2022:full-scale-invasion-un-resolution-es-11-1, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Purported annexation of four oblasts; UN Resolution ES-11/4
claims.summary: Russia proclaimed the annexation of Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson; the UN General Assembly adopted Resolution ES-11/4, condemning the attempted annexation as invalid and calling for non-recognition.

sources.label: General Assembly Resolution ES-11/4, Territorial integrity of Ukraine: defending the principles of the Charter of the United Nations (12 October 2022)
Russia-Ukraine War (2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine)

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Ukraine: From the cradle of Kievan Rus' to a sovereign nation defending its borders against invasion.", terralore.co/country/UKR/chronicle#ev-2022-purported-annexation-of-four-oblasts-un, claim TL:UKR:event:2022:purported-annexation-of-four-oblasts-un, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.
